extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Properties of water — water is a liquid at room temperature, transparent (clear, no colour), no smell, no taste, boils at 100°C (becomes steam), freezes at 0°C (becomes ice), dissolves many things (sugar, salt), water flows. (2) Water as a resource — water is essential for all living things (humans, animals, plants). Uses: drinking, cooking, bathing, washing, agriculture/farming, industries. Sources: rivers, lakes, wells, rain, taps (after treatment). Clean water is safe to drink. Dirty water causes diseases (diarrhoea, cholera). Water should be filtered/boiled before drinking. Save water: turn off taps, fix leaks, use buckets not hoses, collect rainwater. (3) Sun as a natural resource — sun gives us light and heat energy. Solar energy uses: solar panels (make electricity), solar cooker (cooks food without fuel), solar heater (heats water), sunlight helps plants make food by photosynthesis, sunlight dries clothes, sun gives vitamin D for strong bones. Sun is a renewable and free energy source. Water cycle: sun heats water → water evaporates → forms clouds → rains → fills rivers and lakes. Misconceptions: 'water has a colour' (pure water is transparent — no colour), 'all water is safe to drink' (river and pond water may have germs — must be filtered/boiled), 'sun only gives light' (sun gives both light AND heat energy), 'solar energy costs money' (sunlight is free — solar panels cost money but sunlight itself is free), 'water is unlimited' (clean drinking water is limited — we must save it). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function WaterSunGame), NOT export default. Export interface WaterSunGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void.
